findings.claim: All initial state and raw sensor digests match across arms.
Seed4602 earliest genuine prebranch digest/sensor failure is zero-based step7/env2; its B0/B1 t0 is18. Seed4601 earliest is step11/env1 with t0=15.
Earliest failures coincide exactly with first differing reset schedules:4602 B0 first reset step7 env56 versus other arms step8;4601 B0 and B3 first reset step11 envs120,123 versus B1/B2/B4/B5 later.

At earliest failing rows all separately recorded numeric before/actual/root position, velocity, action, command, belief position, target position and RNG probe fields remain bitwise equal. Full state and combined raw sensor hashes differ. Therefore the first recorded divergence is in unexpanded observation/sensor/history components.
reset_idx(env_ids) rewrites vertex_maps_per_env_updated[:] for ALL envs from current actor root poses, then refits only meshes for env_ids.

An unrelated first reset recomputes every scene mesh from post-physics actor poses; small changes such as PhysX-normalized actor quaternions can alter other-env ray casts. This explains sensor-first all-env differences without initial root-state/target/RNG changes. Mesh vertices and static actor root histories were NOT_RECORDED, so this mechanism cannot be proved retrospectively.

Raw RGB/depth/LiDAR were stored jointly as per-env SHA256 digests, so these records cannot identify which raw modality/pixels first changed. Robot orientation/angular velocity and derived kinematics are inside hashes without separate numeric traces; therefore they cannot be numerically excluded.
Main remains INTEGRITY_FAIL. No post-hoc exclusions or salvaged causal sensor/control comparisons. N16 diagnostic does not establish N128 intervention/reset noninterference.

smoke_shared_reset_blindspot.interpretation: Both runs already performed a global Warp vertex refresh at27 and both invoke it again at40. The forced reset tests membership within a shared reset transaction, not a reset-vs-no-reset geometry refresh at the first differing reset step.

future_diagnostics_planned_not_executed.proposal: Use two or more fake scenes, unique actor-to-vertex maps, independent expected per-env transforms and fake mesh.refit counters. Between snapshots change an unselected scene actor pose by a small floating-point increment (including a normalized quaternion fixture), reset a different selected scene, and assert every unselected vertex remains bitwise unchanged while selected geometry follows its expected transform. Existing global reset_idx[:] logic violates that isolation contract. Verify selected-only refit and order/split invariance without Isaac/GPU. This tests the proposed isolation invariant, not whether main actually had such pose changes.

Only with new explicit approval/preregistration: N128 identical-action B0 pair, inject one unrelated reset at an early step with NO natural reset in reference (preferably before its first natural reset), so one process executes a reset and the other does not. Record before/after per-env static actor poses, transformed mesh vertices, robot derived kinematics, root orientation/angular velocity and separate RGB/depth/LiDAR/semantic arrays. Require all untouched envs byte-identical through future steps. Include natural-reset-coincident and noncoincident injections; do not pool/retry the failed P02 measurement.
